title: The Pinned Knight
setup: Black's knight on e7 is stuck between your rook and its own king, but the king guards it.
hint: Rook for knight is a bad trade. Which of your pieces can attack e7 more cheaply?
explanation:
## The Idea

A knight pinned to its king cannot move at all, because every jump leaves the line. {{Rxe7+}} now would lose the rook to {{Kxe7}}, so bring a cheaper attacker. {{d6}} hits the knight and also guards e7. After {{Rd8}}, {{Rxe7+}} takes the knight, and the king cannot take back.

When a pinned piece is defended, do not trade into it: add your cheapest attacker.
